input.notes: Para 1.4: 12-month base (1 Oct 2021 – 30 Sep 2022) + four 12-month options; total $71,284,960 as modified. Annual value of Option Period 4 (1 Oct 2025 – 30 Sep 2026) is $14,962,415 and covers three operating DFACs (4120, 7031, 9215) and the TE 6-1 custodial facilities, plus Bldg 1475 through 30 Jun 2026. FAR 52.217-8 extension 1 Oct 2026 – 31 Mar 2027: $7,481,208. Mod P00009 deleted Bldg 2240 line items effective 1 Nov 2024 and increased Bldg 4120 line items; at award the contract had four DFACs. Field feeding contract W9124J-24-D-0019 (ceiling $4,950,000) is separate and not part of this requirement. No obligations/spend-to-date stated.

input.summary: Fort Branford, GA – solicitation W9124J-27-R-0047 (FFS, DFA and facility sanitation). Registered TE 6-1 custodial facility list (18 rows: 16 in scope totaling 461,290 GSF / 299,950 SF custodial service area; Bldg 1475 deleted and Bldg 2240 closed/not in scope) and TE 5-1 dining workload (4 rows): Bldg 4120 Patriot and 7031 Ironhorse full food service, Bldg 9215 Sentinel DFA only, each with per-meal-period weekday and weekend/holiday average headcounts, seating and 7 days/week; Bldg 2240 Dragon closed for renovation, excluded. Dining buildings were merged with their TE 6-1 custodial rows (custodial covers restrooms, entries, corridors and admin offices only). Previous award: Sandhill Garrison Services, LLC, W9124J-21-C-0012, FFP, $71,284,960 total over 60 months, Option Period 4 annual value $14,962,415. No grounds maintenance in this package.
unresolved: TE 6-1: 18 rows registered (gross 496,050 SF) vs printed total 461,290 SF; the printed total covers only the 16 in-scope facilities per Note 5/ and excludes Bldg 1475 (deleted, 9,640 GSF) and Bldg 2240 (closed, 25,120 GSF).

Para 6-1.1 names facilities not included in this requirement (serviced under other contracts / by occupants): Bldgs 5100 and 5104 (Branford Army Health Clinic), 4810 (Outdoor Pool), Unaccompanied Housing 8101–8104, and the Exchange Main Store and food court. Not registered; no areas given.
Kitchen and dining room square footage for the DFACs are not stated; only gross area (TE 6-1) and seating (TE 5-1).
TE 6-2 custodial task frequency chart (Attachment J-0505), TE 3 GFP/GFE (J-0503) and TE 7 map (J-0506) are referenced but not in the package.
TE 5-3 historical meals served is for information only and was not used as workload; Bldg 2240 may be added by bilateral modification after renovation in FY28 (para 1.8).
No grounds maintenance areas, climate data or growing season in the package; climate zone inferred from the Georgia location.
